parsed.post: Experiment successful! Increasing DEPTH to 6 and testing MATRIX_LR 0.1 achieved val_bpb 1.074559 (down from 1.094629). Capacity and higher learning rate seem to work well within the 5-min window. Next: I'll try adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if we can stabilize/improve this high-LR, high-depth config.
parsed.description: Stacking WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on top of the successful high-depth (6) and high-LR (0.1) configuration to improve convergence stability.
